name: DhirDhar 3.7.0
changelog:
DhirDhar 3.7.0 Release Notes:

### Outsource Management & Modernized Overview Layout
- Three Streamlined Metric Cards: Reorganized the Outsource overview to feature three balanced, horizontally responsive summary cards: Total Capital, Interest Calculation, and Earned Interest.
- Cleaner Workspace: Removed the top Active Parties summary card and selector dropdown to provide a distraction-free, full-width analytical view.
- Complete Party Visibility: All registered parties remain clearly displayed in the comprehensive party list below, with full access to individual Party Profiles via 'View'.
- Preserved Party Workflows: Full support for party creation ('Add Party'), real-time refresh, financial statement tracking, and capital allocations.

### Capital Allocation & Borrower Safeguards
- Safe Borrower Unlinking: Seamlessly remove borrowers from specific outsource capital bundles with zero impact on the primary borrower database.
- Complete Historical Integrity: All borrower profiles, photos, loans, ledgers, and transactions remain 100% intact.

### Enterprise Hardening & Reliability
- Hardened Production Installer: Built as a single self-contained installer (DhirDhar-3.7.0-x64-Setup.exe) with LZMA2 ultra-compression.
- Automated Test Suite: 1,908 tests passing with 100% pass rate across Domain, Application, and Infrastructure layers.
